hints.title: Prefix Function Reusability
hints.text: When a character mismatch occurs while matching needle inside haystack, can previously matched prefix information prevent retreating in the main text?

hints.title: Knuth-Morris-Pratt Fallback Invariant
hints.text: The longest proper prefix that is also a suffix determines the fallback position inside needle without moving the haystack pointer backwards.

hints.title: LPS Construction and Linear Scan Procedure
hints.text: Construct the longest prefix suffix array for pattern needle. Advance pointer i through haystack and j through needle. When characters match, increment both pointers. On mismatch, if j is positive, reset j to lps[j - 1]; otherwise increment i. Return the starting index when j reaches the needle length.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input length or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N + M) time and O(M) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Naive substring checking requires O(N * M) time when repetitive character sequences cause repeated full rewinds.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Preprocessing the needle into an LPS table requires O(M) space and allows O(N + M) single-pass traversal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement linear-time substring search such as KMP or rolling hash rather than brute-force quadratic slicing.
